description.value: Port Moody Liquor Store is part of the Neighbourhood Liquor chain and carries a broad, ever-changing selection of wine, beer, and spirits with a focus on niche and craft products. Staff offer knowledgeable recommendations and the store hosts weekly in-store tastings covering beer, wine, coolers, and spirits. A touring cyclist stopping in will find complementary cookies on weekends and dog treats on request.

address.value: #4 – 2929 St John's Street, Port Moody, BC
